title: Vice Ganda gets another best actor nomination for ‘Call Me Mother’
summary: As Vice Ganda prepares for the upcoming Asian Academy Creative Awards on December 3, he recently received another best actor nomination for "Call Me Mother," this time from the 41st Luna Awards.
